hypotheses.S7_sixteen_canonical_directions_beat_six: Rank-16 path-subspace fidelity exceeds the prior top-64 native-channel fidelity in both anomalous contexts.
hypotheses.S8_the_finite_mlp_change_lies_in_the_pat: Each anomalous finite MLP change has at least 0.95 squared-norm fidelity in its path's top-8 output subspace.
hypotheses.S9_sharpness_does_not_require_higher_pat: The anomalous median output rank-to-90% is no greater than the matched-control median.
hypotheses.S10_gender_paths_share_a_moderately_comp: At most 64 directions explain 90% of all eight gender-edit MLP derivative trajectories jointly.
